description: Verify signal_analyser.py (protected) reads from mcp_signal_enrichments and applies enrichment scores when computing composite signal values. The three weak signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety) all show only 4 distinct values despite v2 enrichments being built at ~20:27 UTC. This bridge module will query enrichment evidence rows and emit diagnostic logs showing whether enrichments are being consumed. Writes nothing to DB; only reads via ws_query and emits structured log entries. If enrichments are not being consumed, this diagnostic will identify the gap for manual fix.
